widgets_values:
{"v": 1, "title": "Settings", "subtitle": "Only Picture 1 is on as it opens. Load it, type, press Run.", "author": "", "body": "### Swap someone in a video
1. Switch on **Video** and **Keep the clip's sound**, and load your clip.
2. Load the new person in **Picture 1**.
3. Clear **What happens** and press **Run**.

Swapping two people? Switch on **Picture 2** too: Picture 1 takes the left one's place and Picture 2 the right one's. Or type who goes, one line each: `@1 the man in the hat`. Two can take a couple of runs.

### Good to know
- Click an arrow on a note to jump to what it points at.
- Purple nodes are switched off and need no file. The switches turn them on.

### A clip came out wrong?
Run it again: the seed changes after every run. Still wrong? Read **Prompt H3 sees** on the right, then say it more plainly, one thing at a time. "Value not in list" means a file is missing.", "models": [], "packs": [], "links": [], "layout": "card", "accent": ""}

{"v": 1, "title": "Your pictures", "subtitle": "Give each picture one job on H3 Prompt Writer. Type @1 for Picture 1, @2 for Picture 2.", "author": "AusBoss", "layout": "card", "accent": "", "body": "- **person**: a clear photo of one person. They go wherever your lines say. Name no place and they stay where the picture shows.
- **character sheet**: for a swap, crop it to one view with the blue handles. A whole sheet can flash up at the start, and a second picture of the same person becomes a second person.
- **place**: a place with nobody in it. Pale bars at the sides of the clip? Crop this picture to the clip's shape with the blue handles.
- **outfit** or **thing**: nobody in the picture. A person in it pulls the face toward theirs, so crop the head off with the blue handles.
- **style**: only the look is used.
- **start on it** or **end on it**: the first or the last moment of the clip.", "models": [], "packs": [], "links": []}

{"v": 1, "title": "Recipes", "subtitle": "What to turn on, and what to type.", "author": "AusBoss", "layout": "card", "accent": "", "body": "- **A story across places.** Nothing extra. One line for each place, with a blank line between.
- **Your own place.** Picture 2 as place: `@1 sits at the counter in @2`
- **Two people.** Picture 2 as person: `@1 and @2 sit side by side on a night bus`
- **A new outfit.** Picture 2 as outfit: `@1 walks down a runway wearing @2`
- **A product film.** Picture 1 as thing: `@1 spins slowly on black glass`
- **Copy a dance.** Video on, as copy its moves: `@1 dances on a rooftop at sunset`
- **That dance, that outfit.** Video on, Picture 2 as outfit: `@1 dances on a rooftop wearing @2`
- **Put someone in a video.** Video on, as swap the person. Type nothing.
- **A longer story.** Video on, as keep going. Load your last clip and type what comes next.", "models": [], "packs": [], "links": []}

{"v": 1, "title": "Your video and sound", "subtitle": "Up to 15 seconds. Pick its job on H3 Prompt Writer.", "author": "AusBoss", "layout": "card", "accent": "", "body": "Drag the handles to the part you want. The clip takes this video's shape, and takes about three times as long to make.

- **copy its moves**: your person does what the video shows. The clothes in the video stay unless your line names new ones.
- **swap the person**: the same video with your person in it. Type nothing. Two people in it? Type who goes: `the child in the seat`.
- **keep going**: more of the clip, from where it ends. Type what comes next. It saves the new part.
- **new voice**: the same video in another voice. Turn **Voice** on and put the words in quotes.

### Voice and Song
**Voice**: about 10 seconds of someone talking, yours or one you have permission to use. Put the words in quotes, on the last line.

**Song**: it plays as it is, and each moment moves onto its beat. With a voice too, it goes under the words.", "models": [], "packs": [], "links": []}

widgets_values:
{"v": 1, "title": "Writing the lines", "subtitle": "One line for each thing. A blank line cuts to a new place.", "author": "AusBoss", "layout": "card", "accent": "", "body": "Lines play in order, in one shot. About one line a second is the most H3 can play. The bars show when.

- **Name the place** in the line after a blank line. A cut inside one place shows every gap, so move somewhere new each time.
- **Think from the new scene.** Say which way they face and where they end up. If they walk away, we see their back.
- **Say what you would see.** `She smiles` works. `She feels happy` doesn't. No steps are filled in: to get on a train, she has to walk to it, then step in.
- **Speech** goes in quotes: `She says "we are late."`

### On a line of their own
- `music:` a dark score with deep drum hits
- `sound:` rain on a tin roof
- `camera:` a slow push in
- `look:` a 1970s film
- `3s:` at the start of a line puts it on that second", "models": [], "packs": [], "links": []}
